_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide 8th Grade - Zearn, uploaded by Loren 8/29/26, transcribed by week from the actual per-week lesson lists (not just header rows). One guide typo found and corrected via lesson-content continuity, matching the pattern from Grade 5's week 28 and Grade 7's weeks 33/34: week 29's header reads 'Mission 8 | Exponents and Scientific Notation | Lessons 9-10', but the body's own section header says 'Mission 7 Teacher and Student Materials' and every row in the body is labeled 'Mission 7' (Mid-Mission Assessment Topics A-B, then Topic C Lessons 9-10) - corrected to Mission 7, which is also required for lesson continuity since Mission 7's Topic B lessons run through 8 in week 28 and Topic C lessons continue at 11-15 in week 30. Every 2-day assessment in this guide has both Day 1 and Day 2 printed inside the same guide-week (unlike Grade 3, where one assessment split across weeks 22-23), so all are recorded without a day tag per the 'drop the day tag when both days land in the same guide-week' rule. Two guide-weeks straddle a mission boundary using only Flex Days from the outgoing mission (week 13 opens with two 'Mission 3 | Flex Day*' entries before Mission 4's Lesson 1 starts; week 27 opens with two 'Mission 6 | Flex Day*' entries before Mission 7's Lesson 1 starts) - Flex Days carry no lesson or assessment content, so neither week's lesson range or assessment string was affected; tagged entirely to the incoming mission. Mission 9 (week 36) is the guide's own optional two-lesson finale mission with no assessment, matching Grade 8's the guide's own note that it is optional. Lesson accounting verified independently: every mission's lessons are contiguous from 1 with no gaps or duplicates across all 36 weeks (Mission 1: 1-17, Mission 2: 1-13, Mission 3: 1-15, Mission 4: 1-16, Mission 5: 1-22, Mission 6: 1-13, Mission 7: 1-16, Mission 8: 1-15, Mission 9: 1-2). No stored Appendix A Grade 8 Zearn row was available in this Project chat to diff against directly (unlike Grades 1-7, none of which had a byLP Appendix A copy for Grade 8 Zearn present here either) - flag for Claude Code to confirm mission boundaries and lesson ranges against the live site's Appendix A copy before wiring in, per the standing rule that the guide's calendar wins if the two disagree once lesson accounting is confirmed clean, which it is here.
